suggested_experiment_name: Fermi-LAT FSRQ blazar jets (3C454.3, CTA102, 3C279 combined)
notes: Combined Fermi-LAT analysis of three flaring FSRQs (3C454.3, CTA102, 3C279) using blazar jets as ALP-photon mixing region. No ALP signal; 95% CL exclusion of g_agamma >~ 5e-12 GeV^-1 for 5 neV <~ ma <~ 200 neV. Encoded as horizontal exclusion line at 5e-12 GeV^-1 spanning the stated mass range.
